Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: priority SLA + 30-day SLO trial and credit plan

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for the productive conversation yesterday. As Stratus's renewal is coming up, I wanted to put a clean proposal on the table so procurement and engineering can align quickly. High level:

- Premium SLA addendum (12-month renewal) with priority support (P1 1-hour response, P2 4-hour response) and an explicit latency SLO: 99th percentile tail <200ms for text-generation API requests under the agreed traffic profile.
- 30-day SLO trial window post-signing to validate our telemetry and thresholds with your traffic; if we miss the SLO during the trial, we’ll provide a 15% credit against the following invoice and a joint remediation plan.
- Capacity uplift: a 20% reserved capacity increase for the first quarter of the renewal in exchange for a 10% renewal credit on the committed reserved spend.

Attachments I can share: a draft amendment summary and a mutual action plan (MAP). If this looks reasonable, I’ll loop in Ops and Legal to produce the amendment and a DocuSign link.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm you’re comfortable with the trial approach and the measurement windows.
2) We circulate an amendment + MAP to contracts for a clean sign-off by end of next week.

Open to adjustments — want to make this low friction for your procurement and engineering teams.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0184

Markus — thanks for the clear proposal. We like the trial-first approach, that helps with org buy-in. Two quick asks from our side before we escalate to procurement: 

1) Can you provide a short spec of how Redwood computes the 99th percentile and the telemetry points (sample windows, ingestion latency, client vs server-side timing)? Our infra folks (copied) need this to map to our observability.
2) Procurement is asking for a MAP with milestones and a DocuSign-ready amendment; they’ve asked for a single point of contact in Legal (contracts@stratus.ai).
3) Regarding credits: Stratus needs the first-quarter uplift to include a 20% credit, not 10%, given our projected usage spike in Q1. Is there flexibility to split the credit (10% renewal + 10% Q1 usage credit) instead of a straight 20% now?

If you can accept the split-credit structure and share the measurement spec, we’ll push to get an approval call on Thursday.

Thanks,
Sophie
VP of Platform Engineering, Stratus AI
